summary: Added __eq__ and __hash__ methods to Todo class for equality comparison and set/dict operations.

changes.description: Added __eq__ method comparing (id, text, done) and __hash__ based on id
Added comprehensive tests for __eq__ and __hash__ methods

notes: __eq__ compares semantic equality based on (id, text, done), excluding timestamps
__hash__ uses id as unique identifier for set/dict usage
Todos with same id are deduplicated in sets
All acceptance criteria from issue #6396 are met
